data.name: Copy the current week's draft to the next week. If the next week already has shifts or modifications, confirmation is required before copying; saving is still required after copying. Vertical buttons on the sides can expand the 36 hours before and after the current week; gray areas are read-only. Charts and forms on this page only edit the current week; to adjust adjacent weeks, switch to the corresponding week. The next week's draft after copying is also previewed in read-only mode. Changes to the current week and copies are saved, undone, and restored uniformly; collapsing does not lose drafts.
data.value: 將本週的草稿複製到下週。如果下週已有班次或修改內容，複製前須先確認；複製後仍須儲存。兩側的垂直按鈕可展開本週前後各 36 小時的範圍；灰色區域為唯讀。本頁的圖表和表單僅能編輯本週；如要調整相鄰週，請切換至對應週。複製後的下週草稿也會以唯讀模式預覽。本週的變更和複製內容會一併儲存、復原及還原；收合後草稿仍會保留。

data.name: Red alerts indicate empty shifts, insufficient rest, or below minimum headcount, but do not block further adjustments. Saving is allowed even if below minimum headcount, but empty shifts and insufficient rest cannot be saved. Validation is applied uniformly across the modified week, adjacent weeks, and other teams upon saving. If any week fails validation, nothing is saved. Departed members can only retain their original shifts; new shifts cannot be added or copied.
data.value: 紅色警示表示班次無人排班、休息時間不足或人數未達最低標準，但不會阻止繼續調整。即使人數未達最低標準，仍可儲存；但班次無人排班或休息時間不足時，則無法儲存。儲存時會一併驗證已修改的週次、相鄰週次及其他團隊。如果任何週次未通過驗證，就不會儲存任何內容。已離隊成員只能保留原有班次；不能新增或複製班次。
